text:
kevin: Heads up — prod user sees intermittent 502s + empty body after we upgraded to @redwood/node@3.2.0 and switched to an edge-compatible build. Repro happens only when we bundle for Edge (esbuild) and ship SSR. Anyone seen this?

maria: Sorry to hear that. Can you paste minimal repro steps and the bundle config? Also any request ids or logs would help. :eyes:

kevin: Quick repro steps below. Happens in our Next Edge lambda only.

```
# package.json
"dependencies": {
  "@redwood/node": "3.2.0",
  "next": "13.5.4"
}

# next.config.js (edge-enabled)
module.exports = {
  experimental: { runtime: 'edge' },
  webpack: (cfg) => cfg
}

# build
npm run build && NODE_ENV=production next start
```

kevin: Bundle analysis shows the SDK entrypoint gets tree-shaken to a tiny stub. When we import like `import Redwood from '@redwood/node'` the default is `undefined` in the runtime, which seems to cause the client to skip adding auth headers. I can share a small repo.

sam: That sounds like conditional export/entrypoint resolution + bundler tree-shaking. Edge bundlers sometimes prefer the ESM entry and drop the CJS compatibility shim, which can change `exports.default` shape. Two quick checks: 1) what Node runtime version is the edge environment using? 2) can you try `import * as Redwood from '@redwood/node'` or `const Redwood = require('@redwood/node').default` in a quick patch?

kevin: Edge runtime is Node 18.x in Vercel. I tried `import * as Redwood from '@redwood/node'` and got a different error: `TypeError: Redwood.createClient is not a function`. Trying `require('@redwood/node').default` in our bundle throws at build time.

jenna: Another thing I've seen — some bundlers replace dynamic `globalThis` references and that breaks runtime feature detection inside the SDK which toggles the auth header shim. Can you dump the bundled file around the client initialization and paste the snippet?

kevin: Pasted the relevant chunk from the minified bundle (deobfuscated lightly):

```
var r=function(){throw new TypeError('Missing runtime')};
var t={};
export default t;
```

kevin: When that runs the request path short-circuits, which on HTTP returns an empty body and status 502/500. Sometimes we also get 401s when the header assembly code runs but token is undefined. Logs: 

```
[2026-03-12T15:22:10Z] requestId=abc123 status=502 body_len=0
[2026-03-12T15:22:10Z] err="TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'token')"
[2026-03-12T15:22:11Z] requestId=abc124 status=401 body_len=142 auth=missing-token
```

infra-bot: Canary deploy for service "web-edge" was rolled back at 15:24 UTC due to increased 5xx rate. (auto)

maria: Escalating to engineering. @sam and @jenna can you take a look? I'm opening a support ticket with the customer with status=investigating.

sam: Looking into it now. If it's bundler removal of the compatibility layer, an interim workaround is to pin to `@redwood/node@3.1.x` (previous layout) and force the CJS path by adding in `package.json`:

```
{"resolutions": {"@redwood/node": "npm:@redwood/node@3.1.9"}}
```

sam: Longer term we should ship a non-ESM-only subpath like `/dist/compat.cjs` and document the Edge bundler compat notes. I'll open an internal ticket.

kevin: I tried the pin — it reduced errors in canary to near-zero. Will keep the pinned version for now while you look. Thanks for the quick triage.

dan: Can you share the small repro repo link here and the exact build artifact that produced the broken bundle? Put it in a private gist or repo. Also include your `package-lock.json` and `esbuild` flags.

kevin: Repo link: https://github.com/redwood-repros/es-edge-signed (private). Steps in README. I already uploaded the bundle artifact `edge-bundle-3101.js` to the ticket.

maria: Filed support ticket #SUP-2026-487 and internal bug BUG-5643, tagging eng-platform and runtime. I'll keep customer updated with the pinned workaround. :thumbsup:

jenna: If anyone else in the thread has a similar Edge + bundler setup, please try `import * as Redwood` and the pin workaround and report results. I'll draft a short note for the docs about bundler compat.

kevin: Will follow up with more logs if anything else pops up. Thanks team. :pray:
